四个固定标签：红▲、黄■、绿●、蓝◆，颜色与形状不可修改: Four fixed tags: red ▲, yellow ■, green ●, blue ◆. Their colors and shapes can't be changed.

所有设置和文件类别回到初始值: Every setting and file class goes back to its initial value.
所有设置都会恢复默认，确定？: Every setting will be reset to its default. Continue?

扫描最多占用 35% 的磁盘读取，几乎感觉不到: Scans put at most 35% read load on the disk. You'll hardly notice them.

整个 NTFS 卷用 MFT 快速扫描，其他位置逐目录硬扫描: Whole NTFS volumes get an MFT quick scan; other locations a folder-by-folder full scan.
